description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Lovely home:* Spacious Home in Highland Parks* Two Porches and a Balcony with Adirondack Chairs* Bicycles (4) Included for Access to the Beach* Blue Mountain Beach Access- 1.3 miles (Parking, Restrooms and Seasonal Lifeguards)* Pool w/Waterfall (Seasonally heated starting in March), Hot Tub, Gazebo, Community Grilling Area, 360-Observation Tower* Close by Redfish Village and Gulf Place Town Center* Under 1 mile to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service *This property is not available to adults Under the age of 25. No Exceptions.* Beachful Bliss is a 4 bedroom home in Highland Parks that backs up to Point Washington Forest. Boasting amazing neighborhood amenities, including a free form tropically landscaped lagoon pool with whirlpool, 360-observation tower, community grilling area, and fire-pit with comfy chairs and couches. Sit, chat and enjoy your favorite drink with your family and friends! From the 4 story observation tower you can see the gulf, the bay, and miles along the coast to Seaside and Sandestin in either direction. This beautiful 4 bedroom, 3.5 bath home is in laid back Blue Mountain Beach, with delicious Blue Mountain Beach Creamery nearby offering homemade scoops, and is walking distance to shops in RedFish Village. Take one of the 4 bikes provided and ride the bike trails down to Seaside, Watercolor or Grayton Beach. The gorgeous kitchen boasts stainless steel appliances. The living room has a flat screen Smart TV for you to access your own Netflix, Hulu or Amazon prime accounts, and there are board games in the TV cabinet in the living room. The central heat/air is zoned separately for upstairs and downstairs and the laundry room has a front loading washer and dryer. With a king size bed in the first master bedroom, a queen bed in the second master bedroom, a queen bed in both guest rooms, and a Queen Sealy sleeper sofa in the living room, this lovely home sleeps 10. Make lasting vacation memories at Beachful Bliss!*We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Bed Setup:First Floor: Master w/ King Bed and private bathroomFirst Floor Living room: Queen Sealy Sleeper SofaSecond Floor: Master w/ Queen Bed and private bathroomSecond Floor: Guest room w/ Queen Bed, with Shared Bath and Walkout BalconySecond Floor: Guest room w/ Queen Bed, with Shared Bath and Walkout Balcony*Parking only available for 2 vehicles in the home's designated paved driveway. Street parking is not allowed. Violations are strictly enforced by the HOA.*AREA ATTRACTIONS: Highland Parks is the newest neighborhood in Blue Mountain Beach featuring a fantastic neighborhood pool with a waterfall, hot tub, gazebo, fire pit, snack bar, and observation tower. The area is the highest point in South Walton County and surrounded by great eateries and local eclectic shops. Highland Parks is perfectly situated between Redfish Village and Gulf Place Town Center on Hwy 30A! Enjoy dining at local favorites The Perfect Pig, Red Door, Local Catch, or Basmati's. Check out the local art scene at Justin Gaffery’s art gallery.Seaside is a fantastic destination, most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. Its incredible architecture has helped to make it famous but also its faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine and the incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous, There are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, tennis -- you'll find it all right here.Bike over to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for some homemade scoops that will have your taste buds coming back! You'll have an array of dining options to choose from! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
